group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
title: Declaring the Futility of Public Bidding and Awarding A Purchase Order Contract – Sof Surfaces, Inc. – Allendale Elementary School Site Improvements Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 2223-0216 - Declaring The Futility Of Public Bidding For The Purchase Of Playmatting Tiles For The  Site Improvement Project At Allendale Elementary School, And Approving A Purchase Order Contract For That Equipment [by and between the District and Sof Surfaces, Inc., Palatine, IL, for the latter to sell and deliver rubber tiles to cover asphalt and facilitate the build of the new play structure for the Allendale Elementary School Site Improvements Project, in the total amount of $66,878.22, with delivery to the District not later than August 30, 2023].
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Buys $66,878.22 of rubber playground tiles from Sof Surfaces for Allendale Elementary
summary: The district is buying rubber tiles from Sof Surfaces, Inc. to cover asphalt and help build the new play structure at Allendale Elementary School. The Board is declaring that public bidding would be futile for this purchase, so the district is buying without a competitive bid. The tiles are due to be delivered by August 30, 2023.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
title: Declaring the Futility of Public Bidding - Agreement Between Owner and Contractor - Musco Sports Lighting, LLC – Allendale Elementary School Mini-Pitch Purchase and Installation Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 2223-0224  Declaring The Futility of Public Bidding for the Purchase and Installation of A Mini-Pitch System at Allendale Elementary School, and Approving a Contract [Agreement Between Owner and Contractor] for That Work [by and between the District and Musco Sports Lighting, Oakaloosa, IA, for the latter to provide its Musco Mini-Pitch System Modular Sports Solution and installation of a modular soccer sports system complete with lighting, fencing, goals, benches, ADA-compliant access, lockable storage, and sports tile play surfacing to ensure student safety for the Allendale Elementary School Mini-Pitch Purchase and Installation Project, in the amount of $123,480.00, with work scheduled to commence on August 10, 2023 and scheduled to last until February 6, 2024].
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Pays Musco Sports Lighting $123,480 to install a mini soccer pitch at Allendale Elementary
summary: Musco Sports Lighting will supply and install a modular soccer system at Allendale Elementary School. It includes lighting, fencing, goals, benches, accessible access, lockable storage and a sports tile surface. The Board is declaring that public bidding would be futile, so the district is contracting without a competitive bid. Work is scheduled from August 10, 2023 to February 6, 2024.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

group: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
title: Agreement Between Owner and Contractor – G & G Builders, Inc. – Lockwood STEAM Elementary School Site Improvements Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of an Agreement Between Owner and Contractor by and between the District and G & G Builders, Inc., Livermore, CA, for the latter to provide installation of tiles, demolition to existing play structure, matting, tetherball poles, and basketball hoops, and other tasks, more specifically described in Bid Form Document 00 31 01, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth,  for the Lockwood STEAM Elementary School Site Improvements Project, in the amount of $212,077.00, which includes a contingency of $25,300.00, as the lowest responsive, responsible bidder, with the work anticipated to commence on August 10, 2023, and required to be completed within forty-five days (45), with an anticipated ending of September 23, 2023.
presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
headline: Hires G&G Builders for $212,077 to upgrade play areas at Lockwood STEAM Elementary
summary: G&G Builders, Inc. will install play surface tiles, remove the existing play structure, and install matting, tetherball poles and basketball hoops at Lockwood STEAM Elementary School. The amount includes a $25,300 contingency (extra money set aside for changes). G&G was the lowest responsive, responsible bidder. Work is expected to run from August 10 to about September 23, 2023.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Addendum, Facilities Use Agreement - A Portion of Former Parker School - Roots Community Health Clinic - Division of Facilities Planning Management

title: Grant Award - Black Educators Initiative Contractor Agreement - Talent/Human Resources Department

title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - Amplify Education, Inc. - mClass Literacy Tool - Academics and Instruction Department

title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - No-Cost - The International Union of Painters and Allied Trades (IUPAT) District 16 - Adult and Career Education Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2022-2023 - No Cost by and between the District and the International Union of Painters and Allied Trades (IUPAT), District 16, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide the basic construction and pre apprenticeship skills training program for individuals seeking to join the finishing trades unions including Drywall Finishers, Floor Coverings, Glaziers, Painters and Specialty, more specifically described in Exhibit A of the Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, via the Adult and Career Education Department, for the period of July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2026, at no cost to the District.

title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - AlciDesigns & Consulting - High School Linked Learning Office
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2022-2023 by and between the District and AlciDesigns & Consulting, El Sobrante, CA, for the latter to plan and facilitate logistics for High School Linked Learning events, including program and invitation creation, registration, guest lists, venue preparation, presentation materials, catering, equipment, decor, and marketing materials; oversee events from conception through post-event; managing on-site preparations, production, and event breakdown, ensuring consistent, high-level service throughout all phases; book venues appropriate for the event as needed; be responsible for hiring all of the vendors necessary to work the event with the client having final approval over all vendors hired; be responsible for booking all catering necessary at the event with the client [District] having final approval over all food and beverages to be served at the event; arrive at the venue at an agreed upon time to set up event and meet any vendors at least 3 hours prior to the start of event; and work a reasonable number of hours sufficient to fulfill … obligations to the client …, for multiple OUSD College and Career Pathways events, via Linked Learning Department,  for the term February 23, 2023 through June 30, 2023, in an amount not to exceed $13,600.00.
headline: Pays AlciDesigns & Consulting up to $13,600 to run Linked Learning events, after work began
summary: AlciDesigns & Consulting will plan and run logistics for multiple OUSD College and Career Pathways events. This includes invitations, venues, catering, equipment and marketing materials. The service period started February 23, 2023, before this approval, and ended June 30, 2023. The Board is ratifying (approving after the fact) the agreement, up to $13,600.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - Oakland Public Education Fund - Special Education Department

title: Amendment No. 2, Services Agreement 2021-2022 - Ross Underwood - Chief Governance Officer
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 2, Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and Ross Underwood, Lincoln, CA, for the latter to support the District with implementation of Measure QQ, including the District's efforts to work with the Alameda County Registrar of Voters or other entities involved, including subcontracting as may be approved by the District, via Office of the General Counsel, in an additional amount of $15,000.00, increasing the not to exceed amount of Agreement from $25,000.00 to $40,000.00, extending the term of the Agreement from October 1, 2021 through June 20, 2023 to June 30, 2024. All other terms and conditions of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.
headline: Adds $15,000 and a year to a consultant's Measure QQ implementation support contract
summary: This amendment adds $15,000 to an agreement with an individual consultant who helps the district carry out Measure QQ, including work with the Alameda County Registrar of Voters. It raises the maximum from $25,000 to $40,000 and extends the end date from June 20, 2023 to June 30, 2024. The board is ratifying (approving after the fact) the change, and the original term had already ended on June 20, 2023.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Amendment No. 2, Services Agreement 2021-2022- Deborah Seiler - Chief Governance Officer

title: Services Agreement 2022-2023 - Epicenter - Charter Schools Office
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2022-2023 by and between the District and Epicenter, Mt. Pleasant, MI, for the latter to provide its platform that will allow for the Charter School’s Office (OCS) to efficiently assess and track data and documents related to charter governance, equitable admissions and enrollment processes, fiscal health and management, enrollment and attendance reports, teacher credentialing, charter board management, and dozens of other compliance-related documents that OCS collects and reviews annually, via Charter Schools Office, for the period of June 1, 2023 through May 31, 2024, in a amount not to exceed $34,500.00.

title: Facilities Use Agreement - District and East Bay Innovation Academy - Marshall School Site Campus - School Years 2024-2025 and 2025-2026
official_text:
Approval by the Board of Education of a Facilities Use Agreement by and between the District and East Bay Innovation Academy (EBIA), a Charter School, for the latter’s use of 27,428 square feet of the Marshall School Site Premises, as delineated in Agreement, and for the rate stated in the Agreement Sections: 
·	3.1.1. For the 2024-25 fiscal year: 2024-25 Proposition 39 per square foot rate
             (excluding utilizes and custodial); and
·	3.1.2. For the 2025-26 fiscal year: 2024-25 Proposition 39 per square foot rate
             (excluding utilizes and custodial) times 1.05,
for the term July 1, 2024, (“Commencement Date”), and, unless sooner terminated under any provision of the Agreement, the Agreement shall end on June 30, 2026 (“End Date”).
headline: Leases 27,428 sq ft of Marshall School site to East Bay Innovation Academy for 2024-26
summary: East Bay Innovation Academy, a charter school, would use 27,428 square feet of the Marshall School site from July 1, 2024 through June 30, 2026. It would pay a per-square-foot rate set under Proposition 39 (a state law on charter school facilities), with the second year's rate 5% higher. Utilities and custodial costs are excluded, and no total dollar amount is stated.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Board of Education - Expression of Intent To Consider, In Good Faith, All Material Revisions - East Bay Innovation Academy

official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 2324-0002 Oakland High School Battery Service Energy Efficiency and Safety [Battery Services Agreement By and Between the District and SolarStorage Fund D, LLC ("SolarStorage") Richmond, CA, an entity, associated with Total Energies, for the latter to install and maintain Battery System, for the Oakland High School Energy Efficiency and Safety Project, for a term of August 10, 2023 through September 16, 2034, with the District paying no upfront costs [or if the System obtains less than 40% Investment Tax Credit, then pursuant to Section 2.a and Exhibit 1, District agrees to pay SolarStorage Two Hundred Thousand Dollars No/100 ($200,000.00) as Battery Service Fees for the period from the Commercial Operation Date through the Expiration Date.]
